title: underscore() does not split an acronym from the following word
body:
`underscore` in `inflection/__init__.py` loses the word boundary after
a run of capitals:

```python
>>> inflection.underscore("HTTPServer")
'httpserver'      # expected 'http_server'
>>> inflection.tableize("XMLHttpRequest")
'xmlhttp_requests'  # expected 'xml_http_requests'
```

Expected: an uppercase run followed by a capitalized word is split
before the last capital of the run ("IOError" -> "io_error",
"HTTPServer" -> "http_server"), as Rails' underscore does. Simple
CamelCase is unchanged ("DeviceType" -> "device_type").
provenance: upstream code at a pinned commit with an injected regression; the oracle is the unmodified upstream file
